Morph
Fade
Dig
Drag
Locksmith
Open and close doors from beyond the grave
A fallen Crewmate who opens and closes doors from beyond the grave to help their team.
Open and close doors as a ghost
Ritualist
Mark targets and reveal their factions
Mark the configured number of players with your Ritual button: in the next meeting the chat will reveal your targets' factions.
Mark players and reveal factions
Saboteur
Cut the lights from beyond the grave
A fallen Impostor who turns off the lights from beyond the grave: non-Impostors get minimal vision.
Blind the Crew as a ghost
Kamikaze
Deceive with your ability cycle and detonate when ejected
You cannot kill: your Deceive button cycles 4 abilities. If ejected during the detonation meeting, the Impostors instantly win.
Detonates when ejected in its meeting
Sniper
Reload your rifle and eliminate from afar
Wait for the reload, stand still to aim and zoom out to see targets through walls. Pick your victim and shoot from a distance.
Shoot distant targets through the map
Dictator
Accumulate votes against and reveal as a fake Mayor
Every meeting you accumulate votes AGAINST you (they never reset). Once the threshold is reached you may reveal in a meeting pretending to be the Mayor.
Reveals in meetings as a fake Mayor
Victim
Keeps secret notes that are revealed on death
Use the Note button to write secret notes that only you can see. When you die or get ejected, every note is revealed to everyone under the "Notes:" title.
Secret notes revealed on death
Amalgam
Resurrect in a body with a new role
As a ghost, channel over a dead body to resume your own life with a random enabled role. If someone reports a body or calls a meeting, the revive fails.
Resurrect in a body with a new role
Echo
Only your anchor sees, reads and hears you.
You are now the Echo from beyond! You are bound to {0}.
Die in a meeting (ejected or guessed) to become Echo.
Your anchor {0} was killed in the round: you are a common ghost again.
Your anchor {0} was ejected in a meeting: you are a common ghost again.
Your anchor {0} was guessed/executed in a meeting: you are a common ghost again.
Your anchor {0} disconnected: you are a common ghost again.

If you die in a meeting (ejected or guessed) you return as Echo: a living player is assigned and only they see, read and hear you. You cannot see anyone's role (the only exception is your anchor, whose name you see in their role color). If you drift away you return to their side; if your anchor dies or disconnects you become a common ghost.
Haunt your anchor from beyond
Lawyer
Sabotage for charges and manipulate the meeting

Sabotage to earn charges (1 per 2 sabotages you start). In round: blackmail 1 player (their name turns grey and in the meeting they can only vote SKIP). In meeting (voting): TERMINAR forces SKIP for everyone and REHACER resets all votes; each use costs 1 charge.
Sabotage for charges and manipulate the meeting
Professor
Retrain crewmates to change their role
Complete tasks to earn retrain charges. In meetings mark a crewmate (or yourself) and after the meeting they can change role between 3 options.
Mark in meetings and grant role change
Isolator
Trap others inside bubbles
Mark living players with Blow and trap them with Bubble: 3 seconds unable to move or use buttons. Shield yourself to become immune to kills.
Mark and trap players in bubbles

Debtor
Make a deal and collect the favor
Mark a living player (Trato). When they use their ability, the favor activates: they owe you a favor and receive your shared task.

Mark a living player with Trato. When they use their ability, the favor activates: they owe you a favor and receive your shared task that progresses for both.
Make deals and collect favors

Companion
Stay close and protect a player

Mark a living player with Accompany: the mark is permanent and you will always see an arrow toward them. If they use an ability, the arrow hides for 3 seconds. If they die, your vote counts twice. In meetings, Hope swaps all votes between you and your companion while they are alive.
